exposure.needed: which dashboards, alerts or queries reference the old metric name envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration

consequence.statement: After upgrading to 1.17.0 the metric is emitted under the new name only, so dashboards, alerts or queries still referencing `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration` will no longer receive data for it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and queries that use `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration`.
